title: Messages to attendees
description: Write to the people taking part in your event. We send it for you and show you how it went.
privacy_description: You only see numbers here. Nobody's email address or phone number is shown.
load_error_description: Nothing was changed or sent. Please try again.
empty_description: Press "New message" to write to the people taking part in your event.

restore.title: We kept the message you were writing
restore.description: It hasn't been sent. Would you like to carry on with it?

notice.sent: Your message is on its way. It usually goes out within a minute or two.
notice.scheduled: Your message will go out on {{when}}.
notice.saved: Your draft is saved. It hasn't been sent.
notice.retried: We're trying again for the people who didn't get it.

reasons_toggle: What do skipped and failed mean?
reasons_skipped_title: Skipped – we didn't send to these, on purpose
reasons_failed_title: Failed – we tried, but it didn't arrive
reasons_none: We don't have more detail about these yet.

skipped_reasons.email_cadence_off: They've chosen not to get emails like this
skipped_reasons.email_channel_disabled: They've turned off emails from events
skipped_reasons.email_destination_missing: We don't have an email address for them
skipped_reasons.email_provider_suppressed: Their email address has stopped accepting our emails
skipped_reasons.in_app_channel_disabled: They've turned off notifications in the app
skipped_reasons.push_destination_missing: They haven't set up phone notifications
skipped_reasons.recipient_ineligible: They can no longer receive messages about this event
skipped_reasons.safeguarding_contact_denied: A safety setting stops us contacting them
skipped_reasons.organizer_broadcasts_disabled: They've chosen not to get messages from organisers
skipped_reasons.events_feature_disabled: Events are switched off for this community

failed_reasons.event_broadcast_email_provider_rejected: The email service refused the message
failed_reasons.event_broadcast_email_provider_suppresse: Their email address has stopped accepting our emails
failed_reasons.event_broadcast_push_provider_rejected: The phone notification service refused the message
failed_reasons.event_broadcast_push_destination_missing: Their phone is no longer set up for notifications
failed_reasons.event_broadcast_push_channel_disabled: They turned off phone notifications before it was sent
failed_reasons.event_broadcast_content_integrity_failed: The message changed while it was being sent
failed_reasons.event_broadcast_safeguarding_unavailable: We couldn't check a safety setting in time
failed_reasons.event_broadcast_provider_failure: A sending service had a problem

actions.retry_note: Nobody who already received it will get it twice.

dont_send.title: Don't send this message?
dont_send.description: It's set to go out on {{when}}. If you stop it now, nobody will get it.

discard_draft.title: Discard this draft?
discard_draft.description: It hasn't been sent. Once it's discarded you can't get it back.

composer.type_legend: 1. What kind of message is this?

types.announcement_description: News, reminders or changes, before or after the event.
types.follow_up_description: Goes to the people who came, once the event has finished.
types.review_request_description: Asks the people who came how it went, once the event has finished.

composer.post_event_audience_note: This kind of message only goes to people who attended, so we've chosen that for you.

segments.attendance_no_show: People who signed up but didn't come

composer.segment_unavailable: Not available for this kind of message.
composer.channels_description: People only receive the ways they've turned on in their own settings.

ways.push: a push notification on their phone

composer.count_zero: Nobody matches this audience yet. Try choosing other groups of people.
composer.count_error: We couldn't count who will get this.
composer.count_incomplete: Choose at least one group of people and one way to send it, and we'll count who will get it.
composer.body_description: Write it the way you'd like people to read it. We add a greeting and a link to the event for each person.
composer.zone_hint: Times are in {{city}} time, where the event is.

errors.segments_required: Choose at least one group of people.
errors.channels_required: Choose at least one way to send it.
errors.time_invalid_dst: That time doesn't exist on that date because the clocks change. Choose another time.
errors.time_in_past: That time has already passed. Choose a time in the future.
errors.post_event_too_early: This type of message can be sent once the event has finished on {{when}}. Choose a time after that, or save it as a draft for now.
errors.nobody: Nobody would get this message yet. Choose other groups of people, or save it as a draft.

composer.confirm_send: This will go to {{people}} by {{ways}}, as soon as possible. You can't take it back once it's sent.
composer.confirm_schedule: This will go out on {{when}} to everyone who matches at that time – currently {{people}}. You can cancel it any time before then.
composer.confirm_replace_note: The earlier version you scheduled won't be sent.
composer.discard_description: What you've written hasn't been sent and will be lost.
composer.working_slow: This is taking longer than usual. Checking whether it went through…
composer.partial: Saved as a draft, but not sent: {{reason}}

errors.send: Your message couldn't be sent. Nothing went out. Please try again.
errors.save: Your draft couldn't be saved. Please try again.
errors.action: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.open: We couldn't open this message. Please try again.
errors.conflict: This message changed since the page loaded, so we've refreshed it. Check it, then try again.
errors.rate_limited: You've done that several times in a short while. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.unknown_outcome: We couldn't confirm whether that went through. Check your list of messages before trying again. What you wrote is kept.
errors.drift_description: Part of this page is out of date. Reload to carry on.

reasons.schedule_in_past: That time has already passed. Choose a time in the future.
reasons.post_event_too_early: This type of message can only be sent once the event has finished.
reasons.audience_empty: Nobody would get this message. Choose other groups of people.
reasons.channel_empty: Choose at least one way to send it.
reasons.body_invalid: Check your message. It may be empty or too long.
reasons.version_conflict: This message changed since the page loaded, so we've refreshed it. Check it, then try again.
reasons.transition_invalid: This message has already moved on (for example, it has started sending), so that can't be done now.
reasons.cancel_after_send_forbidden: It has already started sending, so it can't be stopped.
reasons.idempotency_conflict: That was already done with different details. Check your list of messages before trying again.
reasons.authorization_denied: You're not allowed to do that for this event.

activity.title: What happened to this message
activity.error: We couldn't load what happened to this message.
activity.empty: Nothing has happened to this message yet.

actions.scheduled: It was set to go out
actions.cancelled: It was stopped and won't be sent
actions.retried: We tried again for the people who didn't get it
